html_source: In Davy's Parlour Snug: Self Portrait with Davy Byrne and Martin Murphy, oil on board painting by Harry Kernoff from the mid-1930s. Kernoff is on the left in Trilby hat and glasses, Byrne in the middle with top hat and glasses, and Murphy (a theatrical set designer) on the right in Irish cap. Source: www.artnet.com.
